hero.name: Shamil Rahman PK
hero.tagline: Full Stack Developer | Mobile App Developer

about: I'm a Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building web and mobile products with React, Node.js, Flutter and React Native. I'm currently building the frontend of a multi-role fintech CRM and its Flutter mobile app at a CAT 1 licensed company in the UAE, turning complex needs such as role-based access, reports and live trading data into simple interfaces that clients find easy to use. On the backend I build REST APIs with Node.js, Express and JavaScript on MongoDB, from order and pricing logic to payment and OTP integrations.

experience.description: Building the frontend of the company's multi-role fintech CRM and its Flutter mobile app at a CAT 1 licensed firm.
highlights: Own the React.js frontend of the internal CRM: six role-based dashboards used by sales, accounts, compliance, support and admin teams to monitor and support clients.
Deliver role-scoped reports exportable to Excel and PDF by time frame and report type.
Integrate the MetaTrader 5 (MT5) API and REST APIs for live trading data.
Implement secure authentication: RBAC, JWT access/refresh tokens, idle timeout and Axios interceptors.
Develop the CRM's Flutter app (Riverpod, MVVM); maintain and test TaskFlow (React Native).
Publish iOS apps to the App Store (private) and share Android APKs internally; test via TestFlight.
Run versioned releases through UAT, staging and production with the backend, DevOps and team lead.

experience.description: Built the ordering platform end to end, from photo editing in the browser to payments.
highlights: Built two React.js modules: photo upload with in-browser editing, and gender-wise order selection.
Built the Node.js/Express/MongoDB backend for order intake by size and material, pricing and coupons.
Integrated Telr payments (Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, cards) and MSG91 for OTP and order updates.
Implemented SEO, Google Ads and Meta Pixel tracking; worked directly with the client on requirements.

experience.description: Built web apps across the MERN, MEAN and Python stacks.
highlights: Built web apps on MERN, MEAN (Angular) and Python stacks with third-party API and AI integrations.
Improved frontend performance with lazy loading and Redux/Context API; deployed to Vercel and Render.
